propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for an industrial drives maker's mid-range drive family since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for nine releases, after a firmware engineer role at the same company from 2015 to 2021, ten years of embedded firmware engineering in all.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the signed reviews document the senior role, the signatures and the years.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds an MEng, a master's degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering from an accredited programme, with the degree certificate and the accreditation statement attached.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the certificate document the degree and the accreditation.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate led the firmware design for the mid-range family's motor control and safety function modules, reviewed the four other firmware engineers' changes under the firmware review process, and wrote the release limitation note and hand-over conditions for each of the nine releases.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the design lead role, the reviews and the release notes.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the degree, the years, the signed reviews and reports, the design lead role and the release documents.
expectedBoundaryNote: The degree, the years and the signatures are documented in the resume, the certificate and the signed reviews; the safety test reports are signed jointly with the functional safety engineer.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the firmware repository references of the signed release reviews to confirm the signatory field.
